unitemized.reason: Whether names are meaningful is a subjective judgment of code quality, and 'except in narrow contexts' cannot be determined deterministically.
Configuring an editor/linter is a project-setup recommendation inside a quoted standards file. It does not apply to the run's task in a way that can be observed.
Using environment variables applies only when the change adds configuration, which cannot be expressed as an observable condition. Judging it is subjective.
Whether an exception type is specific enough is a subjective code-quality judgment, with no deterministic check.
Applies only when the change adds external service calls, a condition that cannot be expressed as a predicate. Detecting exponential backoff is not deterministic.
Resource-cleanup correctness depends on what the code means, and no kind covers it.
Applies only when code handles user input, a condition that cannot be expressed as an observable predicate. Whether input is sanitised is a semantic judgment.
